# Calendar Extension for Google Calendar™

> Calendar Extension for Google Calendar™ is a free Chrome extension (version 3.0.5, 7,000 users, rated 4.5/5 from 44 reviews on the Chrome Web Store) that shows today's Google Calendar timeline in the browser toolbar. It adds time-to-event chips ("in 24 min"), quick add, and one-click joins for Google Meet, Zoom, and Microsoft Teams links, so the full Google Calendar tab is only needed for heavier planning. It is an independent product and is not affiliated with Google.

Install: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/google-calendar-extension/dfbpjijneaihingmldgpgcodglkoamoe
